name: the light under things
did: Rubble stopped being a black blob: the ground half of the ambient now carries the sun's bounce, a downward normal keeps a share of the sky, the screen-space AO has a floor, and the grade runs after the sRGB encode instead of before it. Interaction animations lock you in place.
onAccept: The armoury reloads. Your loadouts are kept; anything you had equipped that moved class is still where you left it.
